description: This file contains helper functions and factory methods for creating RLC (Radio Link Control) entity creation messages within a 3GPP-based radio communication system, specifically for SRBs and DRBs, including configuration and notifier setup.

methods.name: fill_rlc_entity_creation_message_common
methods.description: Populates common fields of an RLC entity creation message based on provided parameters.

methods.name: ocudu::odu::make_rlc_entity_creation_message (for SRBs)
methods.description: Creates and returns an RLC entity creation message for a Signaling Radio Bearer (SRB).

methods.name: ocudu::odu::make_rlc_entity_creation_message (for DRBs)
methods.description: Creates and returns an RLC entity creation message for a Data Radio Bearer (DRB), including optional metrics notifier.
